status: rules locked for implementation; not SDK-integrated or approved for production

cluster.wild_rule: wild substitutes for one regular symbol type per cluster; no wild-only win
cluster.overlap_rule: a board cell may contribute to at most one awarded cluster in a single evaluation; deterministic resolver required in SDK port

cascade.multiplier_reset: reset to 1.0 at the start of each paid or free spin

scatter.counting: check initial board and after each tumble in both paid and free spins
scatter.trigger_limit: one scatter award per individual spin/cascade sequence

bonus_round.cap_behavior: free spins are played until the cumulative total reaches 500; further retrigger awards are ignored once 500 total free spins have been awarded/played
bonus_round.free_spin_wins: credited to the originating paid round and subject to its cumulative win cap

hidden_feature.award_type: immediate base-bet multiplier award, separate from free-spin win multiplier
hidden_feature.cap_interaction: hidden award is added to round total; final credited round payout cannot exceed 25000x original paid bet

round_accounting.paid_round_includes: initial paid spin plus all free spins and retriggers originating from it
round_accounting.win_cap: all base wins, free-spin wins and hidden-feature awards combined cannot exceed 25000x original paid bet
round_accounting.payout_precision: integer hundredths of original paid bet multiplier
round_accounting.rounding: round each individual credited payout component to nearest 0.01x using decimal ROUND_HALF_UP; accumulate integer hundredths; never use binary floating-point for wallet accounting
round_accounting.cap_behavior: clip the final credited component to the remaining amount before crediting; stop awarding additional value at 25000.00x

release_constraints: These are locked product rules for implementation, not proof that the game is mathematically balanced.
The 96.5% RTP is a target only until official SDK generation, optimization and independent verification pass.
The 25000x cap and 500 free-spin ceiling must be enforced in math output and wallet accounting, not only in the client.
